question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" on host "blaze8-12" that are also non-deleted (and have non-deleted instance info cache records) on host "blaze8-12", how many matching instances are there, what is the average of their running average memory (MB) within the availability zone, and what is the average of their maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID? Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    i.id,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.availability_zone
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND iic.deleted = 0
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    memory_mb,
    AVG(memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY availability_zone ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS running_avg_memory,
    MAX(id) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_id_window
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS instance_count,
  AVG(running_avg_memory) AS avg_running_avg_memory,
  AVG(max_id_window) AS avg_max_id_window
FROM windowed
